text: I have used a lot of Lululemon in my gym career.  It is great.  I have tried all of their workout clothes except the shoes.  I have some of their casual pants; they are good, too.  The socks last longer than the Nikes--in my experience.  The white workout shirts are expensive, but look great.  One slight flaw with some of the workout shirts is that the collars stretch somewhat quickly; however, I am using them nearly everyday, and lifting heavy, and running frequently.  I am sure they could fix this problem, but it does not really matter.  The shorts are perfect.  I do not like compression shorts, but I have a pair of theirs and they are good.  So while it may be expensive, their workout clothes are good quality and look great.

Great downtown location with a really solid selection. Easy to pop into while exploring Vancouver, and the store was well stocked with plenty of styles and sizes available. Friendly staff and an overall smooth shopping experience.

Having visited three lululemon locations in Vancouver, this store is a major trade-off: fantastic for product advice, but a overwhelming shopping experience.

The Inventory: Stock-wise, this store actually holds a slight edge over 4th Ave, with better availability for popular items and high-demand sizes.

The Staff: The team here is a standout. They are exceptionally knowledgeable, and if they don't know the answer right away, they will go to great lengths to find it. This makes it a great destination if you need guidance and aren't quite sure what you want.

The Atmosphere: Unfortunately, the physical shopping experience isn't amazing. It is consistently a bit overwhelming, busy, and kind of feels like a crowded location.

The Service Bottleneck: Even though the staff in the men's section are eager to help, they are often stretched thin juggling multiple customers at once. Between the busyness and the wait times for assistance, a visit may not be worth it.

Verdict: Knowledgeable staff, but the busiest location. If you need expert product advice, it's worth it; otherwise, you might want to consider another store.

Sydney and Juvette were extremely kind and helpful. Amazing customer service and great communication skills. And a special thank you to Sydney, who went above and beyond to help me find exactly the kind of blazer I had been searching for over the past several weeks! Truly a wonderful shopping experience, thanks to both of them!🙏

I had a very scary , disturbing experience at this location and because of it I will never shop at Robson Lululemon again . I am a regular shopper at Lululemon—have been to multiple locations around North America and this experience bewilders me.

I was here that day to purchase some new clothes and to return some items I had bought before and there was a long line up so I decided to first look at clothes..As one would I went to the change room to try on a piece of clothing from the store , and after I finished , giving the associate the clothing I did not want a police officer came into the store approached me and told me not to steal from the store. The officer told me that one of the associates had called the police on me  because they thought I was going to steal something — please note I wear Lululemon clothing mostly,  and have stepped foot into this store before with no issues— also I am not a criminal , have no criminal record, and NEVER had the police called on me before.

As one could imagine I was very embarrassed and also thought the lady who called on me must have been crazy ( hopefully she doesn’t work there anymore 🙄). Anyways , I was most upset because the items I went there to return the officer told me to put back!! I told them to check the cameras( they could clearly see I walked into the store with my pre- purchased items ) plus my receipt ! They did not care — they told me to give them my items and leave, but the officer did say that I should explain the situation to the front desk the next day along with bringing my receipt to retrieve my items so I don’t just get ripped off lol.

So thats what I did — I went to pick up my items that I had left the day before and to not my surprise , since I already thought the entire situation was odd they declined my receipt and declined checking the cameras.

I never went to this store after that. I find this experience now gives a bad reputation to the brand — specifically I really don’t think that the employee who called on me should be working there, and to call the cops on someone who literally is funding your biweekly cheques is wild.

I was told by the front instead that I can email the Lululemon office/ call them to be refunded or credited for my items.

—To be honest , it didn’t make sense how I was kicked out of the store one day by one employee just to be allowed in the store again any other day as if nothing happened and then on top of it all get ripped off by this huge company.

This experience happened 2 years ago but I remember it as if it was yesterday. —

I was still in shock from how they treated me and tired of the whole experience so I just left it—so I’m down a hundred but with a lesson learned ( and hopefully your lesson learned too )!

The thing that made this the saddest for me was the fact that my mom gave me this gift card for Lululemon,  and I had spent it on these items I was suppose to return. My mom had bought me multiple Lululemon gift cards for me before this one and it was even at this location so that makes me even more angry and upset!

Tbh, I’m not surprised if someone else has a similar experience as me — the company basically stole from my family and me, and tried to gaslight me into thinking I stole from them.

Let me be the idiot that shopped at this Vancouver location so you don’t have to !

Just in case Lululemon wants to make it right with a customer that is keeping them in business…I still have the gift card from my items purchased at this store🙃

store_name: Lululemon Georgia Street Pacific Centre Vancouver
text: I had a pleasant experience at this location because of Natalie. I brought in my sweater and the zipper that broke off it and I asked what could be done. She handled my situation and concerns with professionalism. It’s always nice to leave a store feeling satisfied and Natalie really provided this and deserves the props.

store_name: Lululemon Georgia Street Pacific Centre Vancouver
text:
Having recently visited three lululemon locations in Vancouver, I would rate this store as an overall "OK" experience. It has some major wins, but a couple of trade-offs depending on how you shop.

The Layout & Atmosphere: Unlike some of the darker, more claustrophobic locations, this store features a bright, spacious, and open-concept layout that makes browsing much more pleasant.

The Inventory: The stock here is fantastic. I don't think I've ever visited and failed to find the size I was looking for and they have great variety.

The Service: The staff are friendly and will generally acknowledge you if you look like you're lingering or unsure of what you need.

The Catch: Despite the great stock and welcoming environment, this location isn't the best if you have detailed product inquiries or need help figuring out what you want. While staff will say hello, getting in-depth guidance or helpful direction can be a challenge.

Verdict: If you already know what you want, this is a great store because your size is likely in stock. If you need help choosing or exploring options, you might find the assistance lacking.

store_name: Lululemon Georgia Street Pacific Centre Vancouver
text: I am writing this review for Tricia and Ivana. Both ladies are  really angel. They are very very kind and helpful. They helped me to buy the right items that I need.

store_name: Lululemon Georgia Street Pacific Centre Vancouver
text: I had a very disappointing experience with the cashiers at this location. It felt as though staff lacked basic customer service training. I noticed a lack of basic courtesy with no greeting and no "thank you." Instead of handing the receipt to me directly as is standard, it was just put onto the counter without a word, leaving a strong impression of racial discrimination. Having experienced great service at the Toronto stores, this Vancouver location as well as the other downtown branch falls far short. Management seriously needs to address this issue and improve staff training.

store_name: Lululemon Georgia Street Pacific Centre Vancouver
text: The customer service was excellent; Majo helped me find a warm sweater to keep me cozy. She listened to what I needed and picked out a couple of pieces for me to try. It was a fantastic shopping experience with her assistance.

Of the three lululemon locations I frequent in Vancouver, this is probably the one I visited the most, though it is ultimately a mixed bag.

The Atmosphere: If you are shopping the men's section, the environment is its biggest strength. It is laid-back, well-organized, and refreshingly quiet compared to busier stores. If you prefer to browse unhurried and without the chaos of a high-traffic location, this peaceful setup is fantastic.

The Service: Unfortunately, customer service leaves a lot to be desired. While the team used to be top-notch and knowledgeable a few years ago, staff now seem to actively keep their distance. You will need to go in knowing exactly what you want, be proactive, and spell your requests out in detail if you need assistance.

The Inventory: Popular sizes—such as Medium for tops or 32W for pants—frequently run out of stock due to high local demand. If you need a popular item immediately, you will often find yourself having to head to the downtown location instead.

Verdict: This location is great if you want a quiet, low-stress browse and already know your gear. However, if you need product guidance or specific sizing, you may want to look elsewhere.

Had such a great experience here thanks to Jane! I originally walked in just to browse, but she was so friendly and helpful that I ended up leaving with a top and two pairs of leggings :)

Jane took the time to explain the different lululemon lines, fabrics, and fits, and helped me figure out what would work best for me. I especially appreciated having a Korean educator who really understood Asian Fit and how different styles fit Asian body types. She made it so much easier for me to find pieces that actually fit and suited me well.

It was also great being able to ask questions comfortably in Korean while learning more about lululemon and its different products. Thank you Jane for being so kind, patient, and knowledgeable🩵🩵

They claim this is the first Lululemon store opened by Chip Wilson, but honestly, it doesn’t feel like it. If it’s truly such an important and historic location for the brand, you would expect it to be designed and presented in a way that reflects that significance — something unique or memorable.

The store layout is also a bit strange. There are two completely separate sections for men and women, connected only by a narrow corridor. The men’s section is noticeably smaller and feels like an afterthought, with very limited product selection and almost no variety.

Overall, I didn’t enjoy visiting this branch. If you’re looking for a wide range of items or a more special experience, this location might not be worth the trip.

I’ve always liked Lululemon and have had good experiences with the brand overall, but unfortunately my experience at the West 4th location was a little disappointing. The staff NOT friendly, I felt the customer service could have been more helpful and understanding regarding an issue I had with the material of one of my items.
For a premium brand like Lululemon, I expected a bit more attention and flexibility when dealing with a product quality concern. Hopefully, the store can improve in this area, because I genuinely like the brand and would like to continue shopping there.

Just had maybe the best shopping experience at Lululemon. I have been a long time customer and really have to give it to Edge. He made me feel incredibly welcome and nothing was too much of an ask. He was incredibly helpful, friendly and personable. I hope management at the west 4th location see this and congratulate Edge on being a beyond fantastic employee.

I had a disappointing experience at this location. I accidentally didn’t realize there was a line, and the cashier immediately pointed it out and told me to go to the back of the line, which I did. However, after I got home, I realized that the same cashier had forgotten to remove the security tag from my item. I find it frustrating that my small mistake was noticed immediately, while something as important as removing the security tag was overlooked. I don’t live close to the store, so now I have to make another trip just to have it removed. Very inconvenient and disappointing.

I had a wonderful experience , thanks to Avika. Her customer service was truly outstanding, she was polite, attentive, and went out of her way to make sure I found exactly what I needed. She handled everything with patience and a genuine smile, which made the entire shopping experience smooth and enjoyable.

I stopped by Lululemon to pick out gifts for my bridesmaids, and this lovely sales associate (Jenny 💕) asked if I needed any help. I told her I was having trouble deciding what to give my bridesmaids for my proposal day and mentioned that I’m getting married soon. She was so kind and genuinely excited for me!
Jenny truly went above and beyond , she even shared my story with her manager, and they surprised me with a tumbler as a gift!😍 I was honestly blown away by their thoughtfulness. Such a special and generous gesture!
Thank you so much, Jenny, for making this experience even more memorable. I truly appreciate you! 💖

Im excited to give this proposal box to my bridesmaids!

I visited this branch for both shopping and an exchange, and I received assistance from Amina (I hope I’m spelling her name correctly! 😅).

She was incredibly patient, kind, and professional. She stayed with me the entire time and guided me through everything with so much care. Even when I went to the fitting room, she checked on me three times to make sure everything was okay and asked if I needed a different size.

I’ve visited this location before, but this level of friendliness and patience truly deserves recognition. Management should absolutely not lose such a valuable, professional, and wonderful employee.

Thank you, Amina 😍✨

I was there to see if I can get help with my hoodie which had a broken zipper that I bought about a year ago. I was in a bit of a bad mood because of personal matters and snappy therefore. However, the staff were super accommodating. They helped even tho my bad mood, they were super lovely. They let me replace it and help me choose a new one. Definitely the best customer service, lovely stuff, amazing quality! I’m officially hooked for life!

I had an exceptional experience at Lululemon today thanks to Haley and Parni. Haley was incredibly knowledgeable, and attentive, taking the time to understand exactly what I came in for and offering thoughtful recommendations without ever making me feel pressured. Please ensure he is recognized for his client excellence.

Parni, the Floor Lead, went above and beyond to ensure I left the store completely satisfied. Their professionalism, genuine care, and commitment to outstanding customer service truly stood out. Together, they created a welcoming and enjoyable shopping experience that exceeded my expectations.

It's rare to encounter a team so dedicated to customer satisfaction. Thank you, Haley and Parni, for making my visit such a positive one. I look forward to shopping at this location again! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Busy store inside Richmond mall, long line to pay on the weekend. Not a large store, minimal selection of men and women items. The location downtown is significantly larger with a better selection.

Somewhat difficult to find parking at the mall on the weekend, there are a lot less parking lots now than a few years ago.

This location had a few racks of discounted items which I have not seen at other locations.

Had such a great experience at this Lululemon location! Wing was incredibly friendly, patient, and super knowledgeable. She walked me through so many of their products, explained the differences clearly, and helped me find exactly what I needed. Her service was warm, thoughtful, and never pushy.

Really appreciate her professionalism — made my shopping experience so smooth and enjoyable. Thank you, Wing!

I have been buying products from here for years and never had an issue returning items to my EQ bank card. It's a pretty load master card. This location   told me they don't return money to prepaid cards, but it should work since my card is on the Mastercard network. They were lucky I had another bank card available. So beware when buying, they may not be upfront about what cards you can get a refund to or not.

Since I used to be a fan of their quality, I am very disappointed in the terrible quality of their men’s trousers over the past few years. Stitching came out of pockets, seams, and more within 6 to 8 times of wearing 2 of them. They often did not have my size (33/34) so I bought several pairs when I could find them. Some were not worn for 18 months before I even wore them. When trying to return them, I could no longer find the receipts, so they went by date of manufacture. Over 1 year, of course. No credit, no refund. Waste of money. No longer spending it here. Quality has gotten terrible the past few years.

I needed help processing a return for a purchase I had made in the U.S., and he went above and beyond to help me. His professionalism, initiative, and willingness to go the extra mile were truly impressive and greatly appreciated. Employees like Jordan make all the difference in the customer experience. Thank you, Jordan, for your outstanding service!

This store is a mixed bag. Please train your sales associates, that if they don’t know something, to say “I don’t know, I’m new” or “I don’t know but I will find out for you or refer you to my colleague”. It becomes very embarrassing when you have a sales associate very obviously making up answers to your questions and taking you around the store checking almost every item because they’re unsure about the product you’re asking for. Please don’t do this! The clothes change frequently and it’s totally okay not to know, no one is expecting an expert on lululemon. I used to work in retail so I completely understand that it can be overwhelming and stressful to know everything about the constantly changing clothing lines and locations of the clothes . I usually got very nice sales associates that have impressive knowledge on many of the items, so maybe this was just a new staff member. Either way, it’s totally okay to admit you don’t know or that you’re new and still learning.

I've been shopping here for years and really like all of Lululemon's products for me and my partner.

Unfortunately, my most recent visit to the store felt quite bad. I had purchased a pair of shoes which were on sale, but decided to return them. The first associate that helped me insisted that the return must be on a gift card as per their return policy for items that are on sale. I responded that this isn't true for shoes, as all shoes from Lululemon have a "free 30 day trial" policy regardless of it being on-sale, or full price.

He wouldn't believe me and said "I can ask my manager if you want, at which point he asked for the manager to come over. She repeated what he said and insisted that the refund must only be on a gift card. I then had to pull out my phone and navigate to their own website and show them their own policy which clearly states the customer is entitled to a "full refund" within 30 days. She then hesitated a bit and told me that "oh this is a special policy just for these shoes because it's a new product", even though the same 30 day trial policy exists for all shoes, and it has been like this for a while.

The first associated then finally relented and gave me a full refund, as per their own policy, though his attitude was now short and visibly cold, as if it was somehow offensive to him that I ask they follow their own policy.

Neither offered a simple apology nor took any accountability for their mistake and this ended up being a poor experience for me.

Always a great experience at Lululemon. The store is clean, well organized, and the staff are friendly and knowledgeable. The quality of the products is consistently great, and it’s easy to find something comfortable and stylish. Definitely one of my favourite places to shop for activewear.

Very poor customer service! My hemming order took 9 days, and I didn’t even receive a confirmation email or any communication about the status of my order. I had to travel to West Vancouver twice just to follow up and find out what was happening with my order.
For a brand like lululemon, I expected much better communication and customer service. Very disappointing experience.
